summary.text: Stephanie Flowers is a Democratic member of the Arkansas Senate for District 8, which covers parts of Jefferson, Lincoln, Desha, Lonoke and Pulaski counties.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists House service in the 2005, 2007 and 2009 sessions, Senate service from 2011, and Flowers's occupation as attorney.

According to the Senate biography, Flowers was born in Pine Bluff in 1953 and graduated from Pine Bluff High School, Philander Smith College and the Thurgood Marshall School of Law at Texas Southern University.
The biography says Flowers has been in private law practice since 1982, was first elected to the Arkansas House in 2004 and to the state Senate in 2010.
